BCRED Emerald JV LP Consolidated Schedule of Investments June 30, 2023 (in thousands) (Unaudited)

findings.detail: The extracted CIK-quarter pct_of_net_assets sum exceeds the June 30 consolidated investment schedule total, and the filing contains separate JV schedules with their own net-asset denominators that should not be summed into the parent CIK aggregate.

rationale: PCT01 is an aggregate check. The raw filing's June 30, 2023 consolidated schedule reports Total Investment Portfolio at 200.47% of net assets, and even the broader Total Portfolio Investments, Cash and Cash Equivalents line is only 206.30%. The flagged extract sum is 225.82371080684155%, materially above both filing anchors. The filing also contains separate BCRED Emerald JV LP schedules with their own % of Net Assets denominator, so the most likely mechanism is a scope/lookthrough classification leak rather than a valid parent-level percentage sum.
